stories.title: Pakar ITS Ungkap Jejak Kapal Virgo Sebelum Hilang Kontak di Laut Jawa

en.title: ITS Expert Reveals Virgo Ship's Traces Before Losing Contact in Java Sea
en.summary: A motor vessel named Virgo Transport 8 lost contact while traveling from Surabaya to Banjarmasin, resulting in 6 deaths and 140 people still missing.

stories.title: Penumpang Dievakuasi Usai Kapal Virgo Hilang di Laut Jawa Jadi 153 Orang

en.title: Passengers Evacuated After Virgo Ship Lost in Java Sea Reaches 153 People
en.summary: A combined rescue team evacuated 153 passengers from the Virgo Transport 8 vessel that was lost in the Java Sea, with the Transport Minister overseeing operations.

stories.title: Kapal Virgo 8 Hilang Kontak, Keluarga Berdatangan Cari Kabar Korban

en.title: Virgo 8 Ship Lost Contact, Families Arriving to Seek Information on Victims
en.summary: Families of passengers aboard KM Virgo Transport 8 sought information about missing relatives, with a coordination center established at Tanjung Perak Port.

stories.title: Penjelasan Kemenhub soal Evakuasi Korban Kapal Virgo yang Hilang di Laut Jawa

en.title: Explanation from Transport Ministry on Evacuation of Victims from Missing Virgo Ship in Java Sea
en.summary: Hundreds of passengers from the Virgo Transport 8 vessel, which lost contact while traveling between Surabaya and Banjarmasin in the Java Sea, have been evacuated.

stories.title: Bawa 243 Orang, Kapal Virgo Transport 8 Hilang Kontak di Laut Jawa

en.title: Kapal Virgo Transport 8 carrying 243 people loses contact in Java Sea
en.summary: A passenger and crew vessel on the Surabaya-Banjarmasin route with 243 people aboard lost contact in the Java Sea.

stories.title: Data Posko SAR: Korban Tewas Kapal Virgo Transport Jadi 6 Orang

en.title: Search and Rescue Command Data: Kapal Virgo Transport death toll reaches 6
en.summary: Of the 243 people aboard Kapal Virgo Transport 8, 103 have been evacuated with six confirmed dead.
